parent_objective: audit M2131 candidate qualification result before comparison-panel design or synthesis
blocked_by: M2131 qualification must complete before result audit
supersedes: direct controller ranking from qualified candidate rows
direct paper claim from generated comparison-support smoke proxies

public_gates: M2132 must audit M2131 qualification completeness and guardrails
M2132 must decide whether comparison-panel design is admitted
M2132 must not rerun reset rollout measured execution or execute policy actions
M2132 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat comparison-support smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits qualified-candidate panel and decides whether comparison-panel design is admitted
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: qualification result audit only; no controller ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2131 qualification is incomplete
stop if source candidate counts do not reproduce M2128
stop if qualification support is below threshold and same-panel repair is proposed
stop if audit ranks profiles directly
fallback_plan: route to comparison-panel design if qualified support is sufficient
route to branch synthesis if qualified support is insufficient or too confounded
route to schema repair if qualification artifacts are invalid
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2131 qualification completes and requires result audit

blocked_shortcuts: do not skip result audit before comparison-panel design
allowed_updates: M2132 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for comparison-panel design or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: qualified and diagnostic counts are summarized
supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2132 audits qualification output and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2132.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If qualified candidates are not sufficient, record the negative result and route to synthesis or scenario redesign rather than ranking aggregates.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns qualified-candidate panel evidence into a bounded next-route decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit comparison-panel design but cannot make a paper verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2132 routes to repeated local repair despite sufficient qualified support

hypothesis: M2131 qualification produced enough qualified candidates to admit controlled comparison-panel design, but not direct ranking or paper claims.
success_criteria: qualified and diagnostic counts are summarized
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed
ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write docs/m2132-paper-route-outcome-supported-decisive-comparison-support-candidate-qualification-result-audit.md from M2131 summary and candidate artifacts

decision_rule: M2132 passes if it audits M2131 and selects a bounded next route without rerun or ranking.
